Key public financial management instruments in Côte d’Ivoire, ordered by level of authority (not by precedence within the same level):
1. Constitution of the Republic of Côte d’Ivoire — the highest-level source of budgetary and fiscal provisions.
2. Organic Law No. 2014-336 of 5 June 2014 relating to Finance Laws — governs the preparation, adoption, execution and oversight of finance laws.
3. Organic Law No. 2014-337 of 5 June 2014 establishing the Code of Transparency in Public Finance Management — sets the transparency framework for public finances.
4. Organic Law No. 2015-494 of 7 July 2015 concerning the Court of Accounts — governs its powers, composition, organisation and functioning.
5. Ordinance No. 2019-679 of 24 July 2019 establishing the Public Procurement Code — governs public procurement. Its precedence relative to ordinary laws is not established by the supplied evidence.
6. Decree No. 2014-416 of 9 July 2014 establishing the General Regulation on Public Accounting — a lower-tier public-accounting regulation.
7. Decree No. 2014-417 of 9 July 2014 establishing the State Budget Nomenclature — a lower-tier budget-classification regulation.
8. Decree No. 2014-418 of 9 July 2014 establishing the State Chart of Accounts — a lower-tier accounting regulation.
9. Decree No. 2014-419 of 9 July 2014 establishing the Table of State Financial Operations — a lower-tier financial-reporting regulation.
10. Decree No. 2019-81 of 23 January 2019 establishing the charter for management of programmes and appropriations — a lower-tier programme-budgeting regulation.
